newsitem.title: MACAU: Portuguese President to visit Macau , China.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese President to visit Macau , China.

text.p: Portuguese President Jorge Sampaio will arrive on Tuesday in Portuguese-administered Macau for a six-day visit before travelling to China, the Macau government said on Monday.
The president will be accompanied by a 100-member delegation including Foreign Minister Jaime Gama and Minister for Economic Affairs Augusto Mateus.
He will discuss the transition of Macau to China in 1999, two-and-a-half years after the British relinquish sovereignty of Hong Kong.

During his eight-day visit to China, Sampaio is scheduled to meet President Jiang Zemin, Premier Li Peng, and Qiao Shi, chairman of the standing committee of the National People's Congress, or parliament.
